instruction: Turn around and walk out the double doors. Go across the next room and out the door. Stop once you enter the next room with tile floor.
evidence: 第一段 +175.5°。w0 走出双开门。随后接近直行，穿过下一间并从门出去。end 进入铺着地砖的房间。

instruction: Walk all the way forward and enter another door. Keep walking forward on the red carpet, and stop where the tiles are on the ground, and the end of the carpet.
evidence: 「Walk all the way forward」红毯和前方的门在 +175.5° 之后，不是一直向前。

instruction: Stand with the bed behind you and walk straight down the red carpet. Go into the room with the tile floor and stop after a few steps closer to the middle of the room.
evidence: +175.5° 后床在身后，前方是红毯。之后五段航向变化都很小。end 进入地砖房间。end 已经走进房间几步。

instruction: Exit the bathroom and walk down the hall to the second doorway on your left. Turn left and enter the room through that doorway.
evidence: 「walk down the hall to the second doorway on your left.」w1 是走廊，数不清左侧第二道门。

instruction: Walk out of the bathroom past the sink and shower. Walk through the arched doorway down the hall with the throw rug. Walk into the room with wooden closet doors and two ceiling lamps.
evidence: 「Walk out of the bathroom past the sink and shower.」start 有洗手台，没有看到淋浴。 「Walk into the room with wooden closet doors and two ceiling lamps.」end 有木柜门，没有两盏顶灯。

instruction: Leave the bathroom and walk straight into the hallway. Go straight and enter the office in the second door on your left.
evidence: 「walk straight into the hallway.」进入走廊的第一段是 -106.7°，不是直行。

instruction: Continue forward until you reach the top of the steps and change your direction to the left. Travel forward until you reach the base of the next staircase on your right. Ascend the stairs until you reach the top step. Halt here.
evidence: 上楼第一段 +126.2°，w0 到达楼梯顶部。w2 的下一道楼梯在 -130.2° 右转之后。随后 dy +1.50 和 +0.81，走到顶部。end 停下。

instruction: Go to the top of the stairs and turn left. Go past the fake tree to the base of the stairs and go up the stairs. Stop at the top of the stairs.
evidence: 第一段 dy +0.43，w0 到顶部。上楼时 +126.2°。w1 经过植物，w2 到下一道楼梯底部。dy 继续为正。end 停在楼梯顶部。

instruction: Walk up the steps and turn left. Walk toward the front door and turn right at the steps. Walk up the stairs and stop at the top of the steps.
evidence: 「Walk toward the front door」没有看到前门。

instruction: With the window behind you, walk straight past the table and kitchen area and through the doorway. Keep going until you get to a separate sitting room on the left with blue walls and white couches. Walk into the room and stop once you step on the carpet.
evidence: 「walk straight past the table and kitchen area and through the doorway.」桌子和厨房在 -98.0° 之后，不是直行穿过。

instruction: Walk past the table and chairs. Walk past the bar with the stools. After you pass that turn left and wait near the two white couches and the coffee table.
evidence: 「Walk past the table and chairs.」桌子和椅子在第一段 -98.0° 之后。

instruction: Walk on the left side of the table straight towards the couch and kitchen counter. Walk between the couch and counter and continue until straight. At the large clock on the wall turn left into the sitting area. And stop near the sofa on the left.
evidence: 「Walk on the left side of the table straight towards the couch and kitchen counter.」第一段 -98.0°，不是从桌子左侧直行。

instruction: Turn ro your left and exit into the hallway. Turn left and enter the bedroom and then turn left and enter the closet.
evidence: 写出的短语都有画面。进卧室前还有未写出的 +42.8°。

instruction: Exit the bedroom. Go to the next bedroom on the left. Go to the foot of the bed. Go into the closet across from the blue bed.
evidence: 写出的短语都有画面。到下一间卧室还有未写出的左转。

instruction: Stand so the foot of the bed is to your right and walk out of the room, going past a big mirror on the way. Once outside walk straight until you see an open door to a bedroom on your left. Walk into the room and stand at the foot of the bed with the bed behind you. Walk through the doorway on the left into the closet. Stop in this doorway.
evidence: 「Stand so the foot of the bed is to your right」start 的床在画面里，不能确认床尾在右侧。 「stand at the foot of the bed with the bed behind you.」不能确认床在身后。

instruction: Walk up brown wooden steps, and head inside through sliding glass door. Walk to couch. Wait here.
evidence: 「Walk up brown wooden steps」木台阶在 -82.0° 之后的 w1，start 对着草地。

instruction: Walk straight until you get to a porch. Go up the steps of the porch and into the house using the glass double doors. Wait near the tv.
evidence: 「Walk straight until you get to a porch.」第一段 -82.0°，不是直行到门廊。

instruction: Walk forward and turn right towards the three stairs to enter the house. Walk forward towards the glass door on the very left corner, and stop there.
evidence: 「Walk forward」第一段 -82.0°，不是向前走。

instruction: Turn right and enter through the sliding door. Continue past the TV on the right. Enter the kitchen and wait beside the fridge.
evidence: 「Turn right」第一段是 +56.9° 左转，不是右转。

instruction: Go toward the white table on the patio. Turn right and go inside through the sliding doors. Go through the room with television and into the kitchen. Stop nest to the stove and island in the kitchen.
evidence: 写出的短语都有画面。朝向桌子时还有未写出的 +56.9°，进门后还有 -92.4°。

instruction: Walk toward the white patio table and chairs and go into the house through the glass sliding doors. Pass the grey couches and go into the kitchen. Wait by the toaster.
evidence: 「Wait by the toaster.」end 没有烤面包机。
